Scenes feel more realistic with HDR10, which provides brighter highlights and nuanced shadows for added depth. Black Equalizer improves visibility in the deepest shadows, while Virtual Aim Point increases the accuracy of the player’s aim when the action peaks. Auto Source Switch+ allows instantaneous switching between connected devices without having to flip through multiple inputs. Maintain winning streaks in total comfort with the height-adjustable Ergonomic Stand that easily pivots, tilts, and swivels for the perfect view.
